title: Kicked Spicy Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: A rich and spicy one-pot Jamaican dish featuring kaffir-lime-leaf and a hint of sweetness, this curry is perfect for those who like a little kick in their meal. It is made with chicken, curry powder, and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the curry powder, kaffir-lime-leaf, scotch bonnet pepper, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and add the brown sugar, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Remove the kaffir-lime-leaf and serve hot over rice or with roti.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
